oneLiner: Larder turns the ingredients already in your fridge into a full week of planned meals.
problem: People waste food and money because they buy groceries without a plan, forget what's already in their fridge, and default to takeout when they don't know what to cook with what's on hand.
targetUser: Busy home cooks and families who want to reduce food waste, save money, and stop the daily 'what's for dinner' scramble.
coreFlow: User lists or updates what's currently in their fridge and pantry
User sets preferences (household size, dietary restrictions, cooking time)
App generates a 7-day meal plan prioritizing on-hand ingredients
User swaps or locks in meals they like from suggested options
App produces a shopping list for any missing ingredients
User marks meals as cooked, which updates remaining fridge inventory

screens.name: Fridge Inventory
screens.purpose: Let users quickly add, edit, or remove items currently in their fridge and pantry

screens.name: Preferences Setup
screens.purpose: Capture dietary restrictions, household size, and cooking time constraints to personalize plans

screens.name: Weekly Meal Plan
screens.purpose: Display the generated 7-day meal plan with options to swap or lock individual meals

screens.name: Recipe Detail
screens.purpose: Show ingredients, steps, and prep time for a selected meal

screens.name: Shopping List
screens.purpose: Present a consolidated list of missing ingredients needed to complete the week's plan

outOfScope: Barcode scanning or smart fridge hardware connectivity
Social sharing or community recipe features
